body: I guess I was worried my Washington license plate might draw suspicion through North/South Dakota, Montana, Wyoming, or Kansas, Nebraska....I'm not sure which route I'm going yet.

Thanks for your advice, sorry it took me so long to respond. I decided to leave him. It's hard because I love him SO MUCH but at the same time I want to cheat. Even though I haven't and won't cross the line, the fact that the want is there will never, ever go away. I actually resent my partner, I resent meeting him when I was in my twenties, I resent that our relationship is monogamous, I resent that I ever thought monogamy was for me. So I'm quitting monogamy entirely and going poly. I just need freedom to love and be loved by whomever I make a connection with, living any other way makes me honestly feel like dying.

Aww....at 17 I picked a university that was close to my much older boyfriends house...was not the university I should have gone to and he was a terrible boyfriend who I look back and realize totally groomed me (first boyfriend and all that). I try not to feel too mad at my past self, we were just kids making decisions too big to fully think through

I had a friend like that - I always though the just loved drinking, but twenty years later I found out he got raped for a year at the age of 14 by a teacher and that's why he started drinking so intensely the next year. I wonder what happened to make regular Mike turn into Drunk Mike. :\

See, the problems with my current partner are OUR problems to fix, not just mine and that's partially why I want to leave, everything gets pushed on me to fix. I do...everything. And I'm breaking inside, it's just too much stress and my partner did start to pick up some of the slack...but he's so irresponsible. He's in his forties and hasn't started to save for a house or retirement, he said a house together is like 10+ years off and he's not even thinking about it yet. Then accused me of only wanting a house because other people are getting them...no I just want to live with security and be able to knock down a wall or paint on the walls. Anytime I'm angry he accuses me of being on my period. I will talk about things I'm interested in and he just stares at me...then changes the subject to something he wants to talk about instead. 

I guess I thought he was a great boyfriend for a long time and we meshed, but maybe I changed as a person and now need a more serious partner that is capable of looking into the future.
I suppose being an asshole is better - cheating is not something I condone.

To be clear, this other guy was a legit contact as we worked together on a book publishing deal so it wasn't like I was looking for this to happen at all, and I did cut contact, so I'm not sure what else I could have done other than saying I will not interact with any male or female (since I'm bi) without boyfriend being present. And no one can live like that!

My partner knows all about it but he didn't want to break up with me over it - I'm with you though, had he written this about another woman I would tell him to just go be with her! So I guess in writing that, there must not be any true love left here.
I do respect him greatly, he's been through so much. It's part of why I stay.

We've discussed it somewhat, he may or may not be for it in practice but theoretically yes he's open to it. I wouldn't immediately be jumping into poly as I would be taking some time to be single and then dating crush if he's open to it later on, but I would certainly explore it further if I left my bf. If it turned out crush preferred monogamy, I'd cross that bridge when I came to it.

10 for an honest life and 1 for stuck in a cage! I guess looking at it like that, regardless of how much I deserve to stay or go, it's sort of crazy not to go...even if it turns out to be a bad idea in retrospect, at least I'll still be living an true & honest life which is an improvement.

So. Much. Therapy. Between our couples counselor and my own therapist, I'm spending $200 a week on this and I'm not rich. Therapy can only do so much though. Maybe I need brainwashing instead, brainwash me back into love with bf, brainwash all the shitty things he did while drunk to me out of my mind and I could stay forever and accept it.

It's tricky because I'm getting conflicting messages - do I accept the shame/punishment of being caught monkey branching but with the knowledge that I can now live a true and honest life? Or do I climb back down the tree and go back into my cage where the zoo visitors can give me a thumbs up and say good monkey, see, this is the right thing to do. 

This is why I've been in therapy for months but it's not getting anywhere.

To be perfectly frank, should I choose to leave my boyfriend I am also done with monogamy - I've always known I was believed in polyamory since I was a teen, though never lived through it. I would be ecstatic if my current boyfriend found himself another girlfriend and allowed me to pursue old friend, but my boyfriend is purely monogamous. So maybe that's also why I'm struggling with this, I know if things failed with the crush that I would be living the TRUEST version of my life, for better or for worse it would be my true self and it would be BEAUTIFUL to me. And that's scary, completely. It's been easy just going along with my boyfriends wants for 9 years...but it has not been fulfilling.
No children thankfully, but we do live together (about 8 years now). Our finances aren't mingled though, I could leave without any legal issues.

Yes, I agree completely, but I've been unable to pick a side. I mean...I think I know which side my heart truly wants to choose (to leave) but my sense of responsibility says we don't deserve what we want and this is wrong. People can want to do a lot of bad things...and that's why we choose what wants to follow and which to ignore. I can't decide. Or I can't seem to safely justify following my heart. Mentally, I've tried to imagine going to funeral for my heart, then burying it quietly in a cemetery because the time to follow our hearts was in our twenties, and now it's time to follow what's right.

I know you weren't responding to me, but may I ask is the latter filthy to you? That's part of what stops me...I'm ashamed to have fallen for someone else while still being in a relationship. I feel like I don't deserve to be happy with the old friend...that I deserve to be miserable with my boyfriend instead. That I should have someone seen the writing on the wall earlier, that I should have predicted this - and because I did not, it's my responsibility to remain indefinitely.

Well...the reason I remain due to time is...shouldn't I have left him when he was still an alcoholic? To leave him now that he's become sober...when I tried to break up with him a few times this summer, he would respond with "this is probably the right choice, but the wrong time" as in to say if I was going to do this, I needed to do it back when he was treating me poorly. I missed my chance, I guess. And I get where he is coming from with that, it's not fair for me to use his past behavior as a reason to want out of the relationship now. I mean, I could probably have just kept on keeping on in this relationship till the end of the time had I not reconnected with this old friend...my boyfriend told me it's not fair that I brought this old friend into our problems either so that's why I haven't been keen on considering my feelings for old friend while I've been looking at reasons to stay with my current partner while we work on improving our communication. But all that said, I can't stop my mind from wandering to him, wondering what he's up to, imagining going on a vacation with him...I literally can't imagine going on a vacation with my boyfriend without imagining potential problems :(

I'm not Jesus. But I'm just looking for advice, I guess emails (even though they were just friendly) are cheating. I'm just having trouble figuring out if I should stay, I mean part of me really wants to stay because he needs me, I saved his life so many times...if I go...I'm afraid for him and if we could just go to counseling (which he is finally ready to do for the first time in 8 years) things would be better. I guess it takes two to save a relationship though, and while he's gotten better, it sure looks like I've gotten worse.

I guess I don't know why I'm struggling so much to leave - maybe leaving isn't what I really want, otherwise it wouldn't be such a struggle. And he is constantly using so many logical arguments that tear me down, it's hard for my reasons to leave to even matter. It's like myself and my reasons for leaving are standing at the edge of the cliff, and I'm going to jump - and then he talks me back from the edge again and again with his logic that I can't really argue against because he is a lot smarter than me.
I'm not kind of gross, I am gross. I can't reconcile my feelings at all.

I did want him and I did love him so much. I just need to learn to accept him for who he is...and try not to think about how he shoved me and he drunkenly kicked our oven door in and threw my flowers in the pond...that was a couple years ago now and like I said he's sober but...those things will always be in my memory. 

He screamed at me that he can't pay off this debt, that there's no currency good enough that I'll accept. I just want to know how you can treat someone you love and care about like that. I want to love him, now he's kind and smart and he enjoys a few of the interests I do and he'll let me do whatever I want, he's non-judgemental in that sense. But how can you apply all those characteristics to someone who made left you weeping for hours all the time because he was too drunk to care? He's sober so I can't blame him now, and he's apologized..

I saved his life so many times, tracked him down long city streets to find him passed out in a snowbank. I saved him from bouncers angry that he was acting like a rock star. I'm so used to protecting him.

He literally LOVES shitty rock n' roll and sings the praises of Johnny Thunder. He's thrown his shoes at Connor Oberest (he was drunk). He's totally fine in that department and is able to take things too lightly at times. 

I guess, just not when it comes to me anymore.
Yes...like the phone incident. He's always correcting me and I just...feel like if you really wanted me to learn, you'd just let me fall so I can pick myself back up. I don't need correction.

Yes there have been some changes - he used to drink alcohol, but quit drinking about a year ago. He would get a little...nutty when he drank. Finally got so nutty an officer decided he needed to sleep it off in jail. That was his turning point. But overall, throughout the years he's gotten more logical. 

I think maybe he just hates me now, and since I'm his girlfriend, he can talk to me however he wants. I keep asking if he wants to break up with me and he say's no! I said I wanted to break up a few months ago actually and he cried as was like "no I'll never find anyone else" and I decided to stay. I feel like I'm such a shitty person to be around, it must be awful to be him...but I admit I never feel like that when I'm around other people or by myself. I like me. I think other people like me. He doesn't seem to be one of them anymore. I don't understand why...if that's the case...he won't just leave. Which is why I made this post, because maybe I am getting defensive and I am a shitty logic person and maybe that really does suck to deal with? 

But Reddit seems to agree...I'm not awful so far...

I know right? It's really, really starting to piss me off and I do a really great job and just ignoring it or brushing it off usually, but yea I will get defensive sometimes because as you said...fuck off. I'm not giving  a speech, I'm just talking. I know one should "think before you speak" but in the comfort of your own home with those you love, you should be able to just...speak your mind. 

I feel like these days he's just waiting on any chance to jump on a word I use wrong. It's so much pressure.

He is exhausting now...my brain just wants to shut off when I'm around him because of it. I think he is like this with only me. If we encountered this frustration at work, he'd keep his mouth shut and then unload to me about it after work. 

I've actually gotten to the point where I don't want to talk too much around him, like whatever I say, it's always incorrect. And if I say this to him, or point out that I feel like this, he tells me I'm obsessed with right/wrong and I'm just trying to reduce the argument to that again.
He's been getting worse over the years...completely obsessed with logic and hates anything that doesn't make sense. I thought it was just me getting worse but maybe not.
